messages:
mike: small heads-upwe saw three short late-ingest pockets in eu last night (~1.9k events). looks like uploader lib retry burst. thinking targeted mini-recomputes instead of full-day backfill
olivia: good call. mini windows reduce slot contention. can you list exact windows?
mike: windows: 2026-03-21T01:12-01:20Z, 01:38-01:46Z, 02:03-02:11Z. each ~8m.
dera: from routing POV we should try Dedicated first for packing efficiency, but if tenant has no reserved capacity route to Shared with a strict rate limiter. also limit concurrent windows per-region to 3.
yusuf: agree. also add a per-tenant monthly burst budget so repeated mini-reprocesses don't surprise billing. default 0 unless enterprise opt-in.
ops-bot: JOB: scheduled dry-run (id: eu-mini-210) status: queued
mike: I'll run a dry-run sample (0.5%) to estimate delta and cost. cli: `ri reprocess --region eu --window "2026-03-21T01:12Z/2026-03-21T01:20Z" --sample 0.005 --dry-run --prefer=deds`
olivia: console UX note: surface dry-run results inline (sample_delta, projected_full_delta, estimated_cost, chosen_pool, fallback) + an "apply recompute" toggle. auto-apply if projected_full_delta < 0.03% and cost < threshold, otherwise require ops approval.
dera: safety: if post-run aggregate diff >0.4% notify #incidents and mark run for manual review. fail auto-apply path.
yusuf: can we add a quick pre-check that compares a tiny sketch of pre/post on a sample to catch catastrophic diffs before committing? makes sense as part of dry-run.
mike: dry-run scheduled at 04:30 UTC. will post results and cost uplift per window. tagging @eng-sre in case of alerts. :mag:
ops-bot: REMINDER: oncall (eng-sre) notified for eu-mini-210 at 04:30 UTC
olivia: next steps: (1) document routing precedence (reserved -> burst_opt_in -> shared:rate(100r/s)) (2) console: implement dry-run panel and accept flow (3) enforce per-tenant burst budgets and opt-ins (4) ops-bot alert rule for >0.4% diffs (5) run dry-run and report
dera: i'll add concurrency cap and per-region simultaneous window limit to avoid slot storms.
mike: thanks all, will update after the dry-run.
